calculation.description: Ranks 20-session residual momentum after scaling each asset by its 20-session downside deviation. Negative daily returns only are used for the downside-risk estimate; all inputs are lagged one completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and above both admission gates over the full history and remains positive in 120/252/756-session windows. Small cross-asset cross-sections imply conservative uncertainty; 4,824 daily IC observations across all 15 tradable assets were used.
validation.provenance: Computed by scripts/miner_2_20331111_downside_residual_momentum20.py; library correlation is a preliminary signal-artifact audit and must be deterministically recomputed by the post-Miner gate.
